prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a rear-end collision. The patient had 7 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1186; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain radiating to the trapezius region, mid and low back pain, and intermittent headaches. Initial examination showed restricted cervical range of motion, particularly in rotation and extension, with paraspinal muscle tenderness and mild muscle guarding. Neurological screening was within normal limits, with no motor deficits, sensory changes, or reflex asymmetry noted.

Over the course of seven visits, treatment consisted of manual therapy, soft tissue mobilization, therapeutic exercise for cervical and lumbar stabilization, and instruction in home postural exercises. Pain levels were tracked at each visit and showed steady improvement from the initial presentation. Range of motion in the cervical spine improved substantially by the fourth visit, and headache frequency decreased markedly. Lumbar tenderness resolved more gradually but was significantly reduced by the final visit.

At discharge, the patient demonstrated near-full cervical range of motion with minimal residual discomfort and good functional tolerance for daily activities. Mild intermittent low back stiffness persists with prolonged sitting. The patient was advised to continue the home exercise program, maintain ergonomic awareness at work, and return if symptoms recur or worsen. No further scheduled visits are currently planned.
